Maria (runtime): FYI staging p99 jumped after the model-v7 tokenizer onboard last night. Seen on 2 lanes. Repro locally with sample load.
Raj (ML Infra): ok looking. Any specific traces? batch size or seq distribution changes?
Lucas (profiling): profiler dump from staging (short window):
```
Profiler summary (10s window):
- total tokens: 1.2M
- avg seq len: 142
- batcher: wait padding increased +35ms
- kernel_select: avg 12ms -> 48ms (hot path)
- kernel exec fastpath: p99 18ms -> 22ms
- slowpath kernel dispatch: p99 110ms
```
This smells like kernel selector routing to slowpath due to tokenizer producing new EOS tokens and padding behavior.
ci-bot: perf-checker: staging/bench/model-v7: p99 latency = 98ms (+62%) FAIL
Maria (runtime): thanks Lucas. Raj can you bisect? possible PRs: #1827 tokenizer-normalize + #1844 batching-heuristic-tweak merged together.
Raj (ML Infra): bisect started. quick update: PR #1827 changes tokenizer mapping for eos->50256 and normalizes trailing spaces; alone it increases avg seq len by ~6 tokens. #1844 reduced batch flush threshold to 8ms.
Anika (oncall): user impact: spike coincided with a short Increase in 5xxs (0.3%->0.9%) and retries. Rollout blocked for prod.
Raj (ML Infra): bisect result: revert #1844 (batching tweak) reduces kernel_select time back to baseline; #1827 by itself increases token counts but doesn't trigger slowpath. So interaction between lower flush threshold + slightly longer sequences causes scheduler to assemble batches that hit slow kernel path.
Maria (runtime): actionable: pause rollout for model-v7, revert #1844 in staging and hotfix kernel selector to prefer fastpath for avg_seq < 160. Thoughts?
Lucas (profiling): patch idea: add heuristic: if avg_seq < 160 and percent padding < 12% prefer fast kernels. Quick patch attached:
```
if (avg_seq < 160 && padding_pct < 0.12) choose_fast_kernel();
```
Not perfect but safe.
deploy-bot: revert PR 1844 deployed to staging at 2026-03-18T07:12:04Z by deploy-bot
Raj (ML Infra): staging perf returned to baseline after revert. CI perf-checker now passes.
ci-bot: perf-checker: staging/bench/model-v7: p99 latency = 36ms PASS
SRE Oncall: thanks team. We'll hold prod ramp until we have a more robust fix in runtime and a model tokenization follow-up.
Maria (runtime): opening rollback + follow-up tickets: PERF-438 (kernel-selector heuristic), MODELS-217 (tokenizer-normalization impact analysis). Assigning next steps.
Anika (oncall): adding postmortem note. :eyes:
Maria (runtime): ok closing thread, keep alerts if anything flares.
